title: Engineering programs in the UK that accept the Duolingo English Test
summary: The UK offers world-class engineering programs across disciplines from aerospace to energy, and many accept the DET. Explore leading programs and find the right fit for your goals.
body_markdown:
Many leading engineering programs in the UK accept the[Duolingo English Test](https://bit.ly/3Dn1elO?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) **(DET)** as proof of English proficiency for international applicants. Students can use DET scores when applying to universities including Imperial College London, Southampton, Bath, Warwick, Strathclyde, Durham, and other highly regarded institutions across the UK.


From aerospace and mechanical engineering to computing, energy, and biomedical engineering, the UK and its globally recognised system of Chartered accreditation status gives international students access to a wide range of accredited engineering disciplines and globally recognized degrees. What’s more, the UK’s globally recognised engineering[accreditation system](https://www.engc.org.uk/education-and-skills/higher-education-programmes?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) provides an additional mark of professional quality, recognised by industry and strengthening graduates’ career prospects around the world.


## These UK engineering programs accept the Duolingo English Test


Many leading engineering programs in the UK accept the Duolingo English Test as proof of English proficiency for international applicants. DET-accepting options include Imperial College London and universities such as Southampton, Bath, Loughborough, Warwick, Cranfield, Strathclyde, Durham, Queen's University Belfast, Heriot-Watt, Surrey, and Newcastle.


- [Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and has ten engineering departments covering aeronautics, bioengineering, chemical engineering, civil and environmental engineering, computing, design engineering, earth science and engineering, electrical and electronic engineering, materials, and mechanical engineering.
- [University of Southampton](https://www.southampton.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering options including aeronautics and astronautics, with specialized pathways in areas such as aerodynamics and spacecraft engineering.
- [University of Bath](https://www.bath.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering across architecture and civil engineering, chemical engineering, electronic and electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. Students can also pursue aerospace engineering within its mechanical engineering department.
- [Loughborough University](https://www.lboro.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers specialized study in aeronautical and automotive engineering, combining core engineering fundamentals with preparation for the aviation and automotive industries.
- [University of Warwick](https://warwick.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering programs within a multidisciplinary school, alongside the university's wider strengths in science, technology, and manufacturing.
- [Cranfield University](https://www.cranfield.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and is a postgraduate-only university specializing in engineering, technology, and management. Its engineering-related areas include aerospace, advanced manufacturing, automotive, clean energy, materials engineering, robotics, space, and water.
- [University of Strathclyde](https://www.strath.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and has engineering departments spanning biomedical, chemical and process, civil and environmental, electronic and electrical, mechanical and aerospace, and naval architecture, ocean and marine engineering, as well as design, manufacturing and engineering management.
- [Durham University](https://www.durham.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering within its Department of Engineering. Applicants can explore the university's current engineering courses to find the pathway that best fits their interests.
- [Queen's University Belfast](https://www.qub.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers undergraduate engineering programs including aerospace, chemical, civil, electrical and electronic, and mechanical engineering.
- [Heriot-Watt University](https://www.hw.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers students opportunities to study mechanical, aerospace, chemical, electrical, civil and structural, and architectural engineering.
- [University of Surrey](https://www.surrey.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering degrees including aerospace, astronautics and space, biomedical, chemical, civil, electrical and electronic, mechanical, and spacecraft engineering.
- [Newcastle University](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) accepts the DET and offers engineering programs including chemical, civil, electrical and electronic, and mechanical engineering.


These are some of the leading **UK engineering programs that accept the Duolingo English Test** . English proficiency requirements can vary by degree level and individual program, so international applicants should confirm the current requirements for their chosen engineering course before applying. And explore our complete list of[accepting institutions](https://bit.ly/3XDzpML?ref=blog.englishtest.duolingo.com) to discover even more places your DET score can take you!


## Your engineering goals can help you find the right UK program


The best place to study engineering depends partly on the kind of engineer you want to become.


Students interested in aerospace, for example, might explore the specialized opportunities available at Imperial, Southampton, Cranfield, or Bath. Someone interested in energy could consider universities with deep expertise in energy systems and related technologies. Students interested in manufacturing can look for programs with strong industry connections, while aspiring civil engineers may prioritize opportunities to study infrastructure, sustainability, and the built environment.


Your preferred degree structure matters, too. UK universities offer options including bachelor's degrees, integrated master's degrees such as the MEng, and postgraduate master's and doctoral programs. Compare the specific course content, research opportunities, industry placements, and professional accreditation available within each program.


## The DET can help you take the next step toward studying engineering in the UK


Once you've found UK engineering programs that fit your goals, the DET offers an accessible way to demonstrate your English proficiency. The test costs **$70 USD** , you can take it online from home, and certified results are typically available within 48 hours.


Check the English proficiency requirements for each engineering program on your shortlist, including its accepted tests and required DET score. Then you can focus on finding the program that best fits the engineer you want to become.
